basics.name: Roger Li
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer with a winding path through bioengineering research, software, and product management — comfortable going deep on code while staying fluent with the people who aren't writing it.

work.summary: Frontend development in React, using Tailwind and Base UI. Building with Claude Code and Cursor — including parallelizing work across git worktrees — as part of day-to-day workflow.

work.name: Jumbo
work.summary: Shipped multiple iOS features and helped move the product from B2C to B2B2C. Set weekly roadmaps for engineers with a strong focus on protecting user data, and used analytics to steer the product toward KPI goals.

work.name: VidMob
work.summary: Planned the roadmap across 3 teams as both product owner and scrum master. Worked directly with clients and dug into data to find the product's next highest-value move.

work.name: VidMob
work.summary: Built proof-of-concepts so product teams could weigh cost, risk, and value before committing to new features. Overhauled API docs, including a new public-facing version. Technical lead for partnerships scoping new integrations.

work.name: VidMob
work.summary: Designed and built new features and systems end to end. Rebuilt the email notification system, shipped about a dozen integrations to cut manual workflows, and eventually led the engineering team.

work.name: Epic Systems
work.summary: Guided clients through new software rollouts, recommending configurations tailored to their needs and hitting fixed launch dates.

work.name: Healmet
work.summary: Helped plan a prototype for detecting basic vitals — heart rate, oxygen saturation, EKG — similar to what an Apple Watch does today.

work.name: University Hospitals Cleveland Medical Center
